BiblicalUsage: Peraq means to break off, to discontinue. Daniel told Nebuchadnezzar to break off his sins by righteousness and his iniquities by showing mercy to the poor, if it might lengthen his tranquillity.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a king can break off his sins: Daniel offered Nebuchadnezzar the way out, and the offer still stands for me.
